Free registration remains available. PRIME PRO is a one-time ₦3,000 upgrade. The proposed benefits below are being prepared; the wider paywall will not be switched on until the feature set is complete.

Planned PRIME PRO benefits

  • Complete in-site lesson and revision library across supported subjects
  • Downloadable revision packs and approved workbooks for offline study
  • Unlimited topic-based practice and full-length mock examinations
  • Detailed performance analytics, weak-topic reports and personalised revision plans

Free access stays available: account registration, subject browsing, starter lessons, basic CBT practice, results history and examination news.

Group chat is not included in this first activation plan; we will decide it separately.
